steps.content: You snap your eyes open. The temperature around you drops sharply and the sweat on your back turns cold instantly. You shiver.

Before you are not the high heat and flames in the nightmare, but the familiar ceiling of the MBCC lounge. The buzzing in your ears also gradually quiets down, and you slowly make out the repeating voice in the announcement.

steps.speaker: Announcement
steps.content: ...The expulsion operation has so far been a success. The S-Class Apostle has been suppressed and repelled, and the threat has been temporarily resolved. The FAC will also cooperate with the Ring Research Institute to remain on full alert and continue citywide searches.

steps.speaker: Announcement
steps.content: The battle is not yet over. The Apostle of Ashes is still alive. It has proven its destructive power and will not stop invading. All department members should rest well for the time being and prepare to face the enemy's next attack with your full strength.
Nightingale's voice comes from the PA system, ever so reliable and calm, but also more tired than usual. She was also injured in that battle.
The medical staff in the ward are also busy. Probably due to the heavy post-battle workload, everyone is in a hurry and no one notices you're awake.

You struggle to get up but fail. The burning pain from the blazing shackles lingers. The brief moment of clarity is quickly overshadowed by a headache. You collapse back into bed, stars bursting in your vision.

At that moment, a refreshing coolness spreads from the palm of your hand, soothing the restlessness within you as it flows along your arm. You realize someone has been holding your hand the whole time, and you hear her voice.
...You've just woken up. Don't push yourself right now.
Such a familiar voice. Have you heard it before?
A foreign fragrance wafts over, and you turn your head toward the direction of the voice.
A strange woman, wearing dark green clothes, is leaning on the other side of your bed, holding your hand.
Her eyes are gentle, and she looks at you openly. When you turn to look at her, she smiles slightly.

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: How reckless of you to dare touch those demonic flames with your bare hands. Now that the shackles have been ignited, this fever won't break soon.

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: You're sweating buckets and your brow is all wrinkled with the frown... Did you have a nightmare? What did you dream of?

She raises her hand to wipe the sweat from your forehead. She's surrounded by rising wisps of green smoke emanating a calming energy, the exact power that's soothing the heat within your body. This is a Sinner's power.
You only answer her with a question.

options: This is a healing ability. Who are you?

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: Sinner... That's a kind of criminal here in your state, right? Going to arrest me? I thought the officials of DisCity would be more courteous.

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: You don't remember me, do you... You DisCity officials surely know how to break my heart.

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: I went through a lot of trouble to rescue you from that demonic being. I wish to at least be remembered for the deed.
The foreign fragrance on her grows more recognizable, same as the scent you smelled in your dream just now.

steps.speaker: Woman in Green
steps.content: I am <color=#fb9259>Du Ruo</color>, an envoy from the Eastian Alliance, a distinguished guest invited by Paradeisos to fight the calamity, and also the person who saved your life from the claws of the Sun Crow... I mean, the Apostle of Ashes.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: How about a little "thank you" to start with?

<color=#fb9259>Eastia</color>, the eastern part of the continent across the sea. After the fall of the Perishing Star, the surviving cities of Eastia formed an alliance to strengthen themselves. Hindered by natural disasters, communication with DisCity was difficult.

In N.F. 106, a new round of global calamities struck Eastia gravely, even severing the fragile Hypercube trade. The place was silent for several years, giving rise to rumors of its sinking in DisCity.

Until <color=#fb9259>January 31, N.F. 114</color>.

The envoys from Eastia arrive in DisCity, marking the first official contact between the two continents after <color=#fb9259>eight years</color> of estrangement. It is for confronting a sudden and severe Tide of Ashes.

A new calamitous apostle, <color=#fb9259>the Sun Crow</color>, has invaded DisCity.
